news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Steel Hub Ka Vikaas
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko badhava milega
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ko ek mahatvapoorn udyogik kendra banane mein madadgar sabit hogi

news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar Ki 100 Din Puri
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne apne 100 din poore kiye, jisme kai vikas yojnaon ka shubharambh hua
Sarkar ne vikas yojnaon par vistar se charcha ki, jisme shiksha, swasthya aur kisan kalayano ko mahatva diya gaya
Is avsar par mukhyamantri ne logon ko sambodhit kiya aur unhe vikas yojnaon ke bare mein bataya

news_cards.title: Maa Mudeshwari Boddh Gaya Sulatanganj Aur Mandar Ke Aitihasik Sthalon Ka Vikas
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Maa Mudeshwari Boddh Gaya Sulatanganj aur Mandar ke aitihasik sthalon ka vikas karne ka nirdesh diya hai
In sthalon ko vishwashtariya paryatan kendra ke roop mein viksit kiya jayega
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke paryatan udyog ko badhava degi aur rozgar ke avsar paida karegi

news_cards.title: Nishulk Steamer Ferry Seva Ka Shubharambh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasiriganj-Panapur nishulk steamer ferry seva ka shubharambh kiya
Yeh seva logon ko suvidha pradan karegi aur unke awagaman ko sugam banayegi
Is seva se sthaniya arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega

news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path Ko Vishwashtariya Swaroop Milega
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga path ko vishwashtariya swaroop dena ka nirdesh diya hai
Is pariyojna ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naya Cooperative Bank Ka Gathan
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar state cooperative bank limited ki karyapranali ko adhik prabhavi banane ka nirdesh diya hai
Is bank ka uddeshya sthaniya arthik vikas ko badhava dena hai
Yeh bank Bihar ke vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayega

news_cards.title: Rera Ki Karyapranali Mein Sudhar
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne RERA ki karyapranali ko pardarshi, saral aur digital banane ka nirdesh diya hai
Yeh sudhar ghar kharidaron ke hiton ko sarvoccha prathmikta dega
Is se sthaniya vastu udyog ko bhi badhava milega

news_cards.title: Patna Metro Nirmaan Mein Sugam Yatayat Ka Dhyan
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Patna metro nirmaan ke dauran Nehru path par sugam aur nirbadh yatayat ka dhyan rakhne ka nirdesh diya hai
Yeh kaam sthaniya logon ko suvidha pradan karega
Is se sthaniya arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega

news_cards.title: Gaya Ji Mein 6 Hazar Karod Rupye Ki Ekikrit Ispat Pariyojna
bullets: Mukhyamantri ke samne Gaya ji mein 6 hazar karod rupye ki ekikrit ispat pariyojna ke liye MoU par hastakshar hue
Yeh pariyojna Bihar ke vikas mein mahatvapoorn bhoomika nibhayegi
Is se sthaniya arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Nashamukt Abhiyan
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Bihar mein nashamukt abhiyan ka shubharambh kiya
Yeh abhiyan yuvaon ko nasha mukt banane mein madad karega
Is se sthaniya samaj ko bhi badhava milega
